description: RAW speech as an MP3: one voice reading a script (text), or a DIALOGUE of two or more people (lines), each in their own voice. Not for adding audio to a video (render_ad and generate_video voice their own spots; change_voice re-voices a finished clip). ONE VOICE: text + engine (default 'seed-audio'; also 'eleven-v4', 'minimax-speech', 'kokoro'…) + voice, a preset from that engine (hermoso_capabilities -> voice engines); a name the engine does not have is REFUSED for free with its real list, and a few engines make their own voice (the reply says which voice spoke). DIALOGUE: lines [{speaker, voice, text}] in speaking order. Each speaker keeps ONE voice, no two speakers share one, a speaker with no voice gets one nobody has; up to 10 voices and 10,000 characters, refused for free past that. Default engine: the dialogue model (Eleven v3 Dialogue, voices Aria, George, Sarah, Roger, Laura, Charlie, Callum, River, Liam, Charlotte, Alice, Matilda, Will, Jessica, Eric, Chris, Brian, Daniel, Lily, Bill, or an ElevenLabs voice id; '[laughs]'-style cues work); or name any voice engine (e.g. 'eleven-v4') to read each line on it and join them in order. dryRun:true returns the exact credits and makes nothing; the price quoted is the charge. Paid, priced by characters (hermoso_capabilities lists credits per 1,000).

dryRun.description: true = the exact credits only, nothing made or charged

engine.description: voice-engine id: one voice defaults to 'seed-audio'; a dialogue defaults to the dialogue model ('eleven-dialogue'); or 'eleven-v4', 'minimax-speech', 'kokoro'… (hermoso_capabilities)

expected_credits.description: the get_cost price; refused unbilled if the live price differs

get_cost.description: true: return the price only; nothing runs or bills

idempotency_key.description: chosen once, resent unchanged on retries: the same key never buys twice

lines.description: DIALOGUE: the turns in speaking order

speaker.description: who speaks; the same name keeps the same voice

voice.description: that speaker's voice from the engine's list (or a voice id); omit to be given one

text.description: ONE VOICE: the script to speak (≤900 characters)

voice.description: ONE VOICE: a preset from the chosen engine (e.g. 'Aria'/'George' on eleven-v4, 'stokie_en' on seed-audio); omit for the engine default

name: generate_voice
title: Generate voiceover or dialogue
